lessons_used: 'adoption, new_flow' changes have shown no clear effect across 3 tests.
'sign_in, redesign' changes have consistently shown negative results after noise correction across 2 tests.
'sign_in, reorder' changes have consistently shown negative results after noise correction across 2 tests.
Evidence is still thin for 'adoption, redesign', 'finish, new_screen', and 'finish, redesign' changes, as test results disagree on effect.
Predictions have mostly been overestimated compared to noise-corrected measurements, though rounds 7, 8, 9, 12, 13, and 14 were underestimated.

candidates.title: waiting_time_estimate_display
candidates.change: Displays an estimated time and progress bar on the waiting screen while the pet is being generated.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a high median time of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing user drop-off without status feedback.

waiting.hint: Your desktop pet is currently being configured and prepared.

guard.reason: Displays a progress estimate during a real wait on the generation screen.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high median (201s) and mean (2336s) wait time with clear status feedback.

candidates.title: home_desktop_prep_stage
candidates.change: Adds a dedicated desktop preparation checklist screen while the pet environment is initializing.
candidates.why: Addresses desktop visibility issues reported in support mail and structures the long 201s median wait time into clear progress steps.

new_pet_desktop_prep.headline: Preparing Desktop Canvas
new_pet_desktop_prep.body: We are getting your desktop window ready for your pet.

guard.reason: Adds a valid desktop preparation screen inside the onboarding flow.

candidates.score_note: Addresses both support emails regarding desktop prep and high wait time, but requires new screen.

candidates.title: choose_path_split_layout
candidates.change: Changes the path selection screen layout to a split view showing side-by-side path comparisons.
candidates.why: The choose_path screen currently loses 23.8% of users with an 8s median / 514s mean time.

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Journey
choose_path.body: Select how you would like to create your new desktop companion.

guard.reason: Redesigns path selection into a split layout while preserving both adoption and creation paths.

candidates.score_note: Targets initial 23.8% drop-off step with a split-view layout.

candidates.title: finish_interactive_controls_flow
candidates.change: Appends a new interactive pet controls walkthrough flow after the home intro screen.
candidates.why: Support receives multiple complaints about users being confused on how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after onboarding.

new_pet_desktop_walkthrough.headline: Pet Desktop Walkthrough
new_pet_desktop_walkthrough.body: Learn how to interact with your pet on screen.

components.text: Click and drag your pet anywhere on screen.

guard.reason: Appends a new walkthrough screen after home intro as allowed by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Backed by support complaints about control confusion, but requires building a new interactive flow.

candidates.title: upload_photos_lighting_hint
candidates.change: Displays clear photo quality and lighting tips directly on the photo upload screen.
candidates.why: Support received 3 reports of custom pet creation failing or looking wrong during adoption.

upload_photos.hint: For best results, use well-lit photos with your pet facing the camera directly.

guard.reason: Adds photo quality and lighting guidance on the photo upload screen.

candidates.score_note: Low-cost hint target at adoption step which has the highest drop-off rate (31.6%).

candidates.title: adoption_certificate_loyalty_badge
candidates.change: Adds an official companion license badge component to the adoption certificate screen.
candidates.why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel at 68.4% and takes 89s median time.

guard.reason: Copy uses 'Included' to market a perk, violating the rule against mentioning gifts or free extras in onboarding.

candidates.title: home_intro_stage_redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the home intro screen using a stage layout spotlighting the active desktop pet.
candidates.why: Finishing onboarding overall is only 23.8%, and home intro takes a median of 395s.

home_intro.headline: Welcome to Your Desktop Pet!
home_intro.body: Your companion is now live on your desktop screen.

guard.reason: Redesigns the home intro screen while keeping its onboarding function intact.

candidates.score_note: Finish redesigns have shown modest positive results (+0.6%) historically.

candidates.title: sign_in_existing_pet_notice
candidates.change: Shows a helpful note reminding users to sign in with their existing account to keep previously created pets.
candidates.why: The top support theme (8 emails) is pets going missing or resetting after users sign in again.

sign_in.hint: Sign in with the same account you used previously to restore your existing desktop pets.

guard.reason: Adds a clear account sign-in hint for returning users.

candidates.score_note: Top support theme (8 emails) and targets 27.1% sign-in drop-off with simple notice UI.

candidates.title: waiting_notify_ready_toggle
candidates.change: Adds a notification toggle option on the waiting screen so users get notified when generation completes.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a long mean duration of 2336s, leading to abandoned desktop sessions.

waiting.hint: We will notify you as soon as your pet is ready to jump onto your desktop!

guard.reason: Adds an opt-in notification toggle on the pet generation wait screen.

candidates.score_note: Helps re-engage users abandoned during 2336s mean generation wait.

candidates.title: story_card_layout_redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the initial intro story screen into a clean card layout focused on desktop pet features.
candidates.why: The first step (choose_path/story) sees a 23.8% drop-off right at the start of onboarding.

story.headline: Meet Your Virtual Companion
story.body: Discover how a desktop pet brings your workspace to life.

guard.reason: Redesigns the story screen into a card layout while preserving its job of introducing the pet.

candidates.score_note: Redesign of first step card layout to improve initial 76.2% conversion.
